Class Audience

java.lang.Object
com.ospx.flubundle.mindustry.Audience
public final class Audience extends Object
A set of players that receive the same message, each in their own locale. A message is rendered once per locale, not once per player.

Created by Messenger. Every delivery method takes either a key, a key with arguments, or a Text.
